title: Weekly BIM coordination report: structure and data contract
source: Weekly reports built on 2026-10-27 for a 13-model campus (partial: checks, links, models) and the 6-model Snowdon Towers sample (complete); the Snowdon structure is the standard
principles: Every figure, chart and table comes from a dataset or a named calculation; no number is typed into the text
One dataset per source, keyed by ModelKey (or element pair) and snapshot week; raw outputs per run in REPORTS/<date>
Sections keep their order and ids; a section whose source did not run stays out and is listed under 'Not collected this week'
Week 1 is the baseline: trend rules read 'baseline'; from week 2 they compare with last week's datasets
Recommendations name owning teams and actions, never figures; recurring causes first
Project constants are stated on the page: coordinate authority, tolerance, LOIN target and LOIN basis

constants.AUTHORITY_MODEL_KEY: ModelKey of the coordinate authority model (the user decides)
constants.MODEL_KEY_PREFIX: common ModelKey prefix shortened in charts (optional)
constants.PROJECT_STATUS: the one project status for the whole federation (the BIM manager decides)
constants.PHASES: the agreed phase list, e.g. 'Existing; New Construction' (optional; default: the authority model's phases)

models.grain: one row per model per week
models.collected_by: step 2 ZEN ACC Gate Model Health Check (counts) + step 3 read-only bridge read (position, links, identity, schedules)

columns.name: model
columns.meaning: ModelKey = registry key = Project Information > Building Name

columns.name: in_health_run
columns.meaning: the model was in the batch health run

columns.name: views_not_on_sheets
columns.meaning: views not placed on a sheet

columns.name: revit_links
columns.meaning: Revit link instances in the host

columns.name: building_name
columns.meaning: Project Information > Building Name as read

columns.name: project_status
columns.meaning: Project Information > Project Status as read

columns.name: phases
columns.meaning: the model's phase names in order, separated by '; '

columns.name: shared_ew_ft
columns.meaning: shared position of the internal origin, east-west, feet

columns.name: links_on_own_workset
columns.meaning: link instances on their own XX_<LinkKey> workset

columns.name: links_in_place
columns.meaning: link instances placed as the matrix defines (identity transform when all models share one origin)

links.grain: one row per link instance per week
links.collected_by: step 3 read-only bridge read with links loaded where placement is judged (ARPL-LNK-0002)

warnings.grain: top five warning types per model per week
warnings.collected_by: step 2 ZEN health check 'Top Warning' lines

columns.name: message
columns.meaning: warning text as Revit writes it

loin.grain: one row per model, category and information field per week
loin.collected_by: step 4 count over the INSTANCE PARAMETERS schedule export (ARPL-QA-0002)

columns.name: element_kind
columns.meaning: family elements count towards LOIN; system and analytical rows are reported separately

clashes.grain: one row per clashing element pair per week
clashes.collected_by: step 5 clash run (ARPL-CRD-0001) or a cloud clash service export

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: penetration = planned vertical run through a ceiling, not counted as a clash

columns.name: group
columns.meaning: group id; clashes sharing an element share a group

columns.name: owner
columns.meaning: discipline that moves, by routing priority

calculations.rule: family elements only; fill = filled / instances

calculations.output: model, category, instances, description_fill, type_mark_fill, missing
calculations.rule: family elements only; missing = sum(instances - filled) over fields; top 15 by missing
completeness = sum(filled) / sum(instances) over family elements; system instances counted once (Description rows)

calculations.output: group, pair, level, owner, element, clashes
calculations.rule: top 12 groups by clashes; most frequent level, owner and element (category, family type, id)

calculations.output: models, links, warnings, views_not_on_sheets, model_groups, checks_passed, checks_failed, checks_total, pass_share
calculations.rule: sums over models; pass_share = passed / (passed + failed); baseline and n/c are not counted
top-five rows of every model combined by message; numbered system names normalised ('<name> 31:' to '<name> <n>:')

rules.label: Links complete
rules.pass_when: revit_links = number of models - 1 (every host links every other model), or as the link matrix defines

rules.label: Coordinates
rules.pass_when: |shared_ew_ft - authority| <= TOL_FT and |shared_ns_ft - authority| <= TOL_FT and |angle_deg - authority| < ANGLE_TOL_DEG

rules.label: Project status
rules.pass_when: project_status = PROJECT_STATUS; until the BIM manager sets it, = the status most models carry (a split federation fails the minority)

rules.label: Phases
rules.pass_when: phases = the phase list of the authority model (or PHASES when set): same names, same order, so linked-model phase mapping works

rules.label: LOIN ≥ target
rules.pass_when: model completeness >= LOIN_TARGET; n/c when the model has no LOIN rows

rules.label: Warnings trend
rules.pass_when: warnings <= last week's warnings; 'baseline' in the first week

sections.title: Title, week and one-sentence summary
sections.content: {{PROJECT}} weekly BIM report; 'Week of …'; baseline week or trend week; the summary sentence carries only marked figures

sections.title: Headline figures
sections.content: LOIN completeness; hard clashes (with groups); warnings; checks passing; Revit links; views not on sheets; model groups

sections.title: Recommendations for the team
sections.content: ordered by impact; each: finding, owning team, action; recurring causes first; no figures in the text

sections.title: Largest clash groups
sections.content: table keyed by group, with element ids

sections.title: LOIN completeness by model and field
sections.content: model × field grid of fill rates; state the LOIN basis

sections.title: Largest LOIN gaps by category
sections.content: table keyed by model, category; system and analytical instances reported separately

sections.title: Warnings by type
sections.content: bar chart with full message in the tooltip

sections.title: Rule checks by model
sections.content: table: one row per model, one column per rule; pass, fail, baseline, n/c

sections.title: Link matrix, host by linked model
sections.content: host × link grid coloured by workset and placement

sections.title: Not collected this week
sections.content: every source or rule that did not run, and why

template.for: Claude Dashboard artifact type (one-writer page, dash.* runtime, d3); any other BI tool can read the same CSVs and follow sections, calculations and rules

changelog.change: Rule checks 'Project status' and 'Phases' added; models dataset gains project_status and phases (owner: mixed status/phase is a common multi-discipline problem the coordinator raises every week)
